Smoked Pane Ward.name: Smoked Pane Ward
Smoked Pane Ward.description: The user sweeps a palm and raises a chest-high pane of thin smoked glass between attackers and an ally within reach. It stops fists, blades and thrown objects from the front and casts a pool of real shade behind it even under bright sun, giving the user a shadow to work from; a pistol round or a blow on its weak point shatters it at once, and growing it draws water from the user's body. Strain: moderate.
